cohort: 268 newborns admitted to a special newborn care unit (SNCU), including 61 preterm infants (inborn and outborn) and a randomly selected group of term infants as controls.
finding: Prematurity and low birth weight are associated with increased risk of neonatal death.
mod_finding: 59% of preterm infants were born via vaginal delivery and 41% via cesarean section.
gest_age: Median gestational age of preterm neonates was 31 weeks (49.2% late preterm, 47.5% very preterm, 3.3% extremely preterm).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of preterm neonates was 1.5 +/- 0.41 kg.
